I.O. D.804

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 804
Date 14 - 1 - 30.

January 13, 30.

Sir,

Further to my letter dated December 20,
1929 on the subject of Mrs. Annie Morgan alias Morris,
I regret to have to inform you that despite very
careful inquiries, no trace can be found of this
lady's whereabouts.

Efforts to locate John Price Morris
have been equally unsuccessful.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,

for Deputy Commissioner of Police.

Acting H.B.M. Consul-General,
British Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. O. D. 804
日期 1930年1月14日。

1930年1月13日。

先生：

继我于1929年12月20日就安妮·摩根夫人（Annie Morgan，别名莫里斯）一事致函阁下之后，我很遗憾地通知您，尽管进行了非常细致的查询，仍无法找到这位女士的下落。

寻找约翰·普赖斯·莫里斯（John Price Morris）的努力同样未获成功。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

代警务副总监。

英国驻上海总领事馆
代理英王陛下总领事，
上海。

POLITICAL BRANCH
(FOREIGN SECTION)
DATE 11. 1. 30
(C.I.D.) Office Notes

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL P...
C. I. D. REGIST...
No I. O. D. 804.
Date. 11. 1. 30.

Mrs. Annie Morgan (possible alias Morris).

Sir,

Extensive enquiries have been made to locate this
lady but up to the present no trace of her can be found
in Shanghai. John Price Lorris with whom she was reported
to have been on friendly terms is not registered at the
American Consulate-General, nor is anything known of his
present whereabouts. As there is a possibility that
Mrs. Morgan may be here under another name further enquiries
will be made and a report submitted if she is located.

（批：JB）
（批：AR 11/30）

A. M. Baird
A. S.

A/D. C. I.

（批：Reg. Please draft reply saying inquiries have been unsuccessful. JKS 11/1/30.）

编号 I. O. D. 804。
日期 1930年1月11日。

安妮·摩根夫人（可能化名莫里斯）。

先生：

为寻找这位女士已进行了广泛查询，但截至目前，在上海仍未发现其踪迹。据报与她关系友好的约翰·普赖斯·洛里斯（John Price Lorris）并未在美国总领事馆登记，目前也无人知晓其下落。鉴于摩根夫人可能使用其他姓名在此居住，我们将进一步查询，若找到她，将提交报告。

（批注：JB）
（批注：AR 1930年1月11日）

A. M. 贝尔德 (A. M. Baird)
助理专员

助理刑事侦缉总监

（批注：登记室。请起草回复，称查询未果。JKS 1930年1月11日。）

C. I. D. SECRETARY
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL
P.O. BOX 259. 804
Date.. 23. 12. 29 SHANGHAI.
18th December, 1929.

Sir,

I have the honour to enclose copy
From Paine and Brettell of a letter that I have received from a firm
13th November, 1929.
of solicitors, Messrs. Paine and Brettell,
of Chertsey, England, in which inquiries are
made about a Mrs. Annie Morgan (possible
alias Morris).

I should be grateful for any infor-
mation you may be able to give me regarding
this lady or her present whereabouts.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Consul.
(in the absence of His
Majesty's Consul-General)

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

pages.en:
D. 804.
COPY
Chertsey,
13th November 1929.

Dear Sir,

Henry Shanks decd.

Our client Mr. Henry Shanks of Chertsey
died in January last, and he appointed a Mrs.
Oakley of Chertsey and his Daughter Mrs. Annie
Morgan Executrixes, and he left the residue of
his property to his daughter Mrs. Annie Morgan.

We have been unable to trace the Daughter.

She originally lived in Texas, but we are
given to understand that she left her husband, and
took away her two children with her nearly two
years ago, and neither we nor her Family have
heard anything of her since.

It has been suggested that she has changed
her name to Morris, as she was very friendly with
a Gentleman named John Price Morris, and it is
thought that they may be together.

There is a considerable sum of money due
to Mrs. Morgan, and we are very anxious to get
in touch with her.

It has been reported to us that she may
have gone to either Hong Kong, Shang Hai or
Mexico, and we are writing the British Consuls
at these places to ask if they can possibly help
us.

Yours faithfully,

(SIGNED) PAINE & BRETTELL.

The British Consul,
SHANGHAI.
pages.zh:
D. 804.
副本
切特西 (Chertsey)，
1929年11月13日。

尊敬的先生：

亨利·尚克斯 (Henry Shanks) 已故。

我们的客户、切特西的亨利·尚克斯先生
于今年一月去世，他指定切特西的
奥克利夫人 (Mrs. Oakley) 和他的女儿安妮·
摩根夫人 (Mrs. Annie Morgan) 为遗嘱执行人，并将
剩余财产留给其女儿安妮·摩根夫人。

我们一直未能找到其女儿的下落。

她原居住在德克萨斯州，但我们获悉，
她在近两年前离开了丈夫，并带走了
她的两个孩子，此后我们及她的家人都
未再听到她的任何消息。

有人推测她已改姓莫里斯 (Morris)，因为她
与一位名叫约翰·普赖斯·莫里斯 (John Price Morris)
的绅士关系非常密切，人们认为他们可能
在一起。

有一笔可观的款项应付给摩根夫人，
我们非常希望能与她取得联系。

据向我们报告，她可能已前往
香港、上海或墨西哥，我们正在致信
这些地方的英国领事，询问他们是否能
提供帮助。

此致，

(签名) 佩恩和布雷特尔律师事务所 (PAINE & BRETTELL)。

英国领事，
上海。
